integrity: Explicit determinant factorization and strict-concavity proof, with supplementary self-contained numerical checker. Previous records and independent scientific review are not certified by this package.
scientific_limitations: The exact D-optimum is restricted to one fixed south pole, three regularly spaced nodes at one height, and five regularly spaced nodes at a second height. No unrestricted Fekete-point optimum, worst-case condition-number optimum, or finite-precision error theorem is claimed; unindexed equivalent prior work remains possible.
title: Exact determinant-optimal latitudes for nine-sample quadratic spherical harmonics
